description: Frozen actual old-eval rule and repair milestone from KLYPIX brain, captured before the current-guidance fix. Historical measurements are fixture text, not current product claims.

cards.text:
Brain: 🛠️ THE EVAL HARNESS IS BROKEN
 AND ITS NUMBERS ARE INVALID —
verified by running it, 2026-08-10,
not inferred.
`scripts/eval-semantic.mjs` (Jul 15)
uses `pooling:'mean'`, `prefix=false`
 by default (line 97/109) and passes
ALL card texts as ONE tensor with no
batching; production
`klypix-mcp/src/semantic-memory.mjs`
uses `EMBEDDING_POOLING='cls'`,
`EMBEDDING_QUERY_PREFIX='Represent
this sentence for searching relevant
passages: '`, and
`EMBED_BATCH_SIZE=16`
bounded-by-default with a 152MB
incremental on-disk cache at
~/.claude/project-brain/embeddings.
The eval file's own comment claiming
it "faithfully mirrors klypix-core's
embedTexts (mean-pool + normalize)"
IS NOW FALSE — production moved to
cls + query-prefix and the eval never
 followed. TWO CONSEQUENCES: (1) the
harness CANNOT RUN on the 2,377-card
brain at all — it requested a
28,210,888,704-byte ONNX allocation
and died with FusedMatMul BFCArena
failure; (2) every semantic figure in
 scripts/.brain-eval-history.jsonl
was measured in a DIFFERENT VECTOR
SPACE than ships, including the 40%
recall@5 quoted publicly on the
landing page. The ONLY number
reproducible today is the lexical
ranker `scoreCardsAgainstQuery`: MRR
0.003, recall@5 0%, recall@10 0%,
recall@20 5%, top1 0% (n=20 frozen
human set, real brain) — and that is
NOT the ranker brain_ask uses (it
flows through rankForQuestion), so
**brain_ask's true recall is
currently UNKNOWN and unmeasurable**.
 IMPORTANT SCOPE: the product is FINE
 — the batching bug is in the TEST
harness only. FIRST FIX: point
eval-semantic.mjs at the production
semantic path instead of its own
stale copy — that repairs the pooling
 drift and the OOM in one change,
because production is already batched
 and cached. Do this BEFORE any
confidence-floor, connector or
retrieval work: all of it would be
optimising against a number nobody
has.
#brain #file-landing #dir-public
#file-feedback-copy-not-design
#dir-memory

Brain: 🏁 EVAL HARNESS FIXED AND
brain_ask MEASURED FOR THE FIRST TIME
 (2026-08-10).
`scripts/eval-semantic.mjs` (not
generated; sole consumer is
brain-eval.mjs, so zero blast radius)
 now DELEGATES embedding to
production
`scripts/semantic-memory.mjs` via
`embedTexts`/`dot`/`getEmbedder`
instead of its own hand-copied
implementation — fixing
mean-pooling→cls, the missing
EMBEDDING_QUERY_PREFIX on the query
leg, and the unbatched single-tensor
call that asked ONNX for 28GB and
made the harness unrunnable on the
2,377-card brain. STRUCTURAL GUARD
against re-drift: the contract is
read from production at runtime and
printed in `mode` every run
("pooling=cls · query-prefix=yes"),
so divergence shows up in output
instead of silently changing what the
 numbers mean. FIRST VALID
MEASUREMENT, n=20 frozen human set,
real brain: rankForQuestion = MRR
0.222 · recall@5 30% · recall@10 35%
· top-1 15%. The drifted receipts had
 recorded MRR 0.087 / recall@5 15% —
**the broken harness was UNDERSTATING
 the product by roughly half**, so
the brain was always better than its
own test claimed. 🛠️ REUSABLE RULE:
an eval must never re-implement a
production primitive "faithfully" by
hand — it must import it. `--lib` may
 swap the candidate RANKER under
test, but the EMBEDDER stays pinned
to production, because an eval that
embeds differently measures a system
that does not ship.
#brain #file-feedback-copy-not-design
 #dir-memory #file-eval-semantic
#dir-scripts
